text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're visiting the shrine today.

text_block_list.name: Chief Priest
text_block_list.text:
Please, dear Umamusume... I leave the
shrine in
your hands.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, you've gotta get it together! Come
on! Stay
with us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chief priest falls ill and entrusts
the
shrine to
Tamamo Cross for a short time
while he recovers.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Never thought I'd be filling in for the
priest, but if
the shrine needs me, I'll
step up to the plate!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I hope he recovers quick. In the
meantime, I'll be
here to talk to the
visitors.

text_block_list.name: Female Students
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! The priest's an
Umamusume! She's so
cute!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey! No screaming! Aren't ya
here to
pray?

text_block_list.name: Female Students
text_block_list.text:
And she serves a real sharp quip! She's
even more
cute once you hear her speak!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What? I don't get it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The wisecracking Umamusume priest
becomes the
talk of the town, attracting
more visitors to the
shrine.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Guess I should wish for something while
I'm here.
Okay...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I wish for everything to turn out okay. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What kind of a wish is that? Just
"okay"?!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitors
text_block_list.text: Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This is weird. I'm glad the shrine is
bustling with visitors, but why are they
all watchin' me? Do
they think I'm funny
'cause I'm from Naniwa?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh. In that case, I guess I'll just keep
being
myself.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've got a comeback for everyone! The
funnier
they are, the better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Let's see who will visit and what kind of
reaction
they'll get.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hey Yaeno, Ardan, come over here!
Let's pray!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Good friends Sakura Chiyono O, Yaeno
Muteki,
and Mejiro Ardan arrive at the
shrine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Dear God... Please hear my prayer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... sorry, I feel lightheaded. The stone
stairway
up here was pretty steep.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then catch your breath before ya start
talkin'!
You're leavin' the gods hangin'
here!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This silence...
It's perfect for practicing
the
ancient martial arts.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No! You're supposed to pray!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She's right,
Yaeno. It's important to visit the
shrine properly. I have a proverb for
that in my
notebook.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Those who believe are saved."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What are you talkin' about? That doesn't
even
have anythin' to do with what we
said!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitors
text_block_list.text: Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Seriously, what is up with those guys?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
At least they gave me some good
material to
work with! The visitors loved
it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her three quirky visitors, the
humorous
priest gains even more
popularity.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Silent, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aw, come on! Ya gotta say somethin'!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You got it! ☆ Something!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Rubae! Miracle! Wahey! ☆
Boo-boo-boom!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I didn't literally mean "something"! Don't
be so
pleased with yaself!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitors
text_block_list.text: Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's visitors were either silent or
completely nonsensical, but Tamamo
Cross still managed to
get some laughs
out of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dirt runners Hokko Tarumae, Copano
Rickey, and
Wonder Acute arrive at the
shrine.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if my prayers will really do
anything,
but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I pray that I will be able to make my
hometown of
Tomakomai proud.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'd feel kinda bad making fun of
that wish.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, the red color from the torii
gate is in
this position so...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're well protected from
natural
disasters here, Priest. Great
landform! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Um, thanks...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Agh, what am I even supposed to say to
that? I
guess these dirt runners just have
a different kind
of vibe.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: There, there. Would you like a sweetie?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross fails to make her usual witty
comebacks and ends up being
consoled instead.
Her enthusiasm
dwindles.
